scope: Native saved workspace repository/folder access management, Recents integration and owned presentation
source_relationship: Native macOS security-scoped bookmark management required by App Store adaptation; this window is not an additional upstream resource dialog or a claim of source dialog completion. Reuses existing original upstream command artwork.
implementation: File → Open Recent → Manage Repository Access remains available for an empty archive and reuses one native window
Repository and additional-folder tables with independent availability/stale renewal and full-path help
Bookmark checking preserves recent order/timestamps and releases temporary scopes; targeted extra renewal tolerates an unavailable sibling
Primary folder renewal/replacement rejects non-repositories and duplicate saved roots while retaining identity/extras
Owned Add/Replace folder pickers, Remove/Forget questions defaulting to Cancel, captured target identity and one-shot replies
Workspace busy/Quit and access-window operation gates, forced close/sheet cancellation and late reply rejection
Live scopes survive saved-grant removal/Forget; repository files and independent Finder-watch archive remain untouched

native.scope: Native table columns, window reuse, independent renewal/status, failed bookmark creation, invalid/duplicate root choice, Cancel/default question, target captured before later selection, duplicate replies, busy/Quit gating, live scope after Forget, actual owned NSOpenPanel retirement and late picker/question replies, plus existing metadata-opening and Clone/Init ownership cases

visual.repair: The first behavioral checks passed, but screenshot review found the Close button clipped after hosting-controller initial sizing. Set an explicit content size and usable minimum size, then rebuilt and repeated both native cases with current light/dark captures. Initial captures were not published.

cleanup.method: Runner reaped each receiver; subsequent ps check found initial/final owned PIDs absent. Native assertions retire owned access windows and close their sheets.
